title: Studio Cryo, Drumstation vs. Eternia poster, Cross Club 2018
lede: A dark event poster with a red line-up band at the top and a rendered collage of clear plastic, smoke, rock, and dripping flowers.
summary: Black ground, red type band, rendered clear-plastic shapes, orange smoke, and dripping flowers. Studio Cryo (Mindaugas Gavrilovas), 2018.

source.label: AIGA Eye on Design (5 September 2019): “Acid Graphics” Are the New Psychedelia

made: 2018 (Eye on Design file name and caption). The poster gives the date “07.12”.

evidence.note: Inspected the 1200 px image `Studio-Cryo-Drumstation-VS-Eternia-event-Cross-Club-2018.jpg` that [Eye on Design](https://eyeondesign.aiga.org/acid-graphics-are-the-new-psychedelia-with-a-heady-dose-of-cynicism/) published with the article, in a scratch folder. Not stored. The object is a digital image as the magazine published it, not a named physical copy. Eye on Design names Mindaugas Gavrilovas and Studio Cryo in the article text.

styles.note: Partial fit: a black ground, rendered clear and metallic forms, and flyer-style line-up type, but in red and orange, with no chrome lettering.

context: [Eye on Design](https://eyeondesign.aiga.org/acid-graphics-are-the-new-psychedelia-with-a-heady-dose-of-cynicism/) names Studio Cryo and Mindaugas Gavrilovas in its 2019 article and shows this poster, captioned as the Drumstation vs. Eternia event at Cross Club, 2018.
observed: A red band at the top holds “DRUMSTATION VS. ETERNIA” in heavy grotesque capitals, “CROSS CLUB 07.12” in a thin, flared display face, and two blocks of small capitals with the line-up.
A red rule separates the band from a near-black image field.
The field holds rendered, transparent plastic shapes with engraved circles, a brown rock surface, a plume of orange smoke, and a bunch of red and white flowers that drip blue and white paint.
A perforated mesh surface crosses the lower right.
There is no green and no chrome type.
interpretation: The poster shows the rendered-object side of the trend: glossy clear materials, smoke, and drips on black, with a dense club line-up. It shares the mood and the rendering, not the chrome lettering.
borrow: Confine all type to one dense band, and give the rest of the sheet to a single rendered scene on black.
Pair a heavy grotesque with a thin flared display face in the same band.

rights.statement: No image is stored. The work is recent and in copyright. The rights holder is the designer or the client.
